description.fallback: [Anime-only side story] Naruto, Chōji, and Hinata are sent to help some peddlers move out of the Land of Vegetables. Because of a package from Tsunade, the peddlers mistake them for "The Konoha Moving Service". Unbeknownst to them, a group called the Janin, have taken control of the land and are looking for one of the peddlers.
